Turn some training images gray, keeping their channels.

With the given probability a training image becomes its luminance (0.2989 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B) in every channel, so the shape stays the same (torchvision RandomGrayscale). One-channel images are unchanged. Validation and test images pass through unchanged.

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Random Grayscale is a training image transform: the image batcher runs it on the ArrayFire device between Resize and Normalize; PipelineExecutor image transforms are not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a preprocessing step |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
Resize -> Random Grayscale -> Normalize -> Conv2D
```

```text
With the given probability a training image becomes its luminance in every channel, so the model's input shape does not change. Validation and test pass through.
```

## Tips

- Makes a model rely less on colour.
